# M0-S1: the logos command is the same binary as go, selected by argv[0].
# logos version reports the logos version; go version keeps upstream text.
logos version
stdout '^logos version go1\.27\.2'

go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2'

# logos help names the logos command.
logos help
stdout 'logos <command> \[arguments\]'

# Logos mode never switches toolchains.
env GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.99.0
logos version
stdout '^logos version go1\.27\.2'
